items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: I remember Bunny Briggs when he was a young kid doing those things back there then. And the strange thing about Bunny, I worked with Charlie Barnett, and Bunny was dancing with that band for a while.

ctx.x: Do you ever see Bunny anywhere? I don't know what happened to him.
No. Last time was in New York, and that was quite a while ago.
